# GraphQL Contract: Custom HTTP Headers for Webhooks

**Feature**: INFP-445 | **Date**: 2026-03-11

## New Types (auto-generated from schema)

```graphql
# Generic interface
interface CoreKeyValue {
  id: String!
  display_label: String
  name: TextAttribute!
  key: TextAttribute!
  description: TextAttribute
}

# Static key-value pair (plain-text value)
type CoreKeyValueStatic implements CoreNode & CoreKeyValue {
  id: String!
  display_label: String
  name: TextAttribute!
  key: TextAttribute!
  description: TextAttribute
  value: TextAttribute!
}

# Password key-value pair (masked value)
type CoreKeyValuePassword implements CoreNode & CoreKeyValue {
  id: String!
  display_label: String
  name: TextAttribute!
  key: TextAttribute!
  description: TextAttribute
  value: TextAttribute!  # Returns "***" via filter_sensitive
}

# Environment variable key-value pair
type CoreKeyValueEnvironmentVariable implements CoreNode & CoreKeyValue {
  id: String!
  display_label: String
  name: TextAttribute!
  key: TextAttribute!
  description: TextAttribute
  value: TextAttribute!  # Contains env var name, not resolved value
}
```

## Modified Types

```graphql
# CoreWebhook gains headers relationship
interface CoreWebhook {
  # ... existing fields ...
  headers: NestedPaginatedCoreKeyValue  # NEW
}

type CoreStandardWebhook implements CoreNode & CoreWebhook {
  # ... existing fields ...
  headers: NestedPaginatedCoreKeyValue  # INHERITED
}

type CoreCustomWebhook implements CoreNode & CoreWebhook {
  # ... existing fields ...
  headers: NestedPaginatedCoreKeyValue  # INHERITED
}
```

## Mutations (auto-generated from schema)

### Key-Value CRUD

```graphql
# Create
mutation CoreKeyValueStaticCreate($data: CoreKeyValueStaticCreateInput!) {
  CoreKeyValueStaticCreate(data: $data) {
    ok
    object { id name { value } key { value } value { value } }
  }
}

mutation CoreKeyValuePasswordCreate($data: CoreKeyValuePasswordCreateInput!) {
  CoreKeyValuePasswordCreate(data: $data) {
    ok
    object { id name { value } key { value } value { value } }
  }
}

mutation CoreKeyValueEnvironmentVariableCreate($data: CoreKeyValueEnvironmentVariableCreateInput!) {
  CoreKeyValueEnvironmentVariableCreate(data: $data) {
    ok
    object { id name { value } key { value } value { value } }
  }
}

# Update (same pattern for all types)
mutation CoreKeyValueStaticUpdate($data: CoreKeyValueStaticUpdateInput!) {
  CoreKeyValueStaticUpdate(data: $data) {
    ok
    object { id name { value } key { value } value { value } }
  }
}

# Delete (same pattern for all types)
mutation CoreKeyValueStaticDelete($data: CoreKeyValueStaticDeleteInput!) {
  CoreKeyValueStaticDelete(data: $data) {
    ok
  }
}
```

### Webhook Header Association

```graphql
# Add headers when creating a webhook
mutation CoreStandardWebhookCreate($data: CoreStandardWebhookCreateInput!) {
  CoreStandardWebhookCreate(data: $data) {
    ok
    object {
      id
      name { value }
      headers { edges { node { id name { value } key { value } } } }
    }
  }
}

# Update webhook to add/remove headers
mutation CoreStandardWebhookUpdate($data: CoreStandardWebhookUpdateInput!) {
  CoreStandardWebhookUpdate(data: $data) {
    ok
    object {
      id
      headers { edges { node { id name { value } key { value } } } }
    }
  }
}
```

## Queries

```graphql
# List all key-value pairs
query CoreKeyValue {
  CoreKeyValue {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        display_label
        __typename
        name { value }
        key { value }
        ... on CoreKeyValueStatic { value { value } }
        ... on CoreKeyValuePassword { value { value } }  # Returns "***"
        ... on CoreKeyValueEnvironmentVariable { value { value } }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Query webhook with headers
query CoreStandardWebhook($id: String!) {
  CoreStandardWebhook(ids: [$id]) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        name { value }
        url { value }
        headers {
          edges {
            node {
              id
              __typename
              name { value }
              key { value }
              ... on CoreKeyValueStatic { value { value } }
              ... on CoreKeyValuePassword { value { value } }
              ... on CoreKeyValueEnvironmentVariable { value { value } }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Notes

- All CRUD mutations and query types are auto-generated by the schema engine from the `GenericSchema`/`NodeSchema` definitions
- No custom GraphQL mutations are needed; the existing `InfrahubWebhookMutation` handles relationship updates via standard input types
- Password values are masked by the existing `_filter_sensitive()` mechanism on the `Password` attribute kind
